meta.name: How To Lose A Wife And Find A Lover ( 1978)
meta.description:
FOR ADULTS ONLY! 18+Original title: Come perdere una moglie e trovare un'amante
Castelli is an advertising executive who, having returned home early due to a car accident with Eleonora Rubens, a young Dutch woman abandoned by her husband, surprises his American wife in intimacy with the plumber.
